description: Full details of one slowhop.com place: type, summary, highlights and the host's description (Polish), address and coordinates, setting, rating and recent reviews, every unit (house/room/tent: capacity, area, rooms and beds, pets accepted), check-in/out times and quiet hours, house rules, pets policy (kinds accepted, limit, rules), who it suits, food and kitchen, amenities (comfort, kitchen, garden, wellness included, extra-paid extras with prices), internet, nearby activities/restaurants/shops/sights with distances, getting there, fees, discounts (last-/first-minute, long stay, children), payment and cancellation terms, the lowest upcoming price and photos. With date_from/date_to it also prices the stay for the party with Slowhop's own calculator: whether it is bookable (free, minimum stay met, the group and pets fit), the exact total and per-night price in the place's currency (PLN in Poland) with a breakdown, the units used and a booking link. Get the slug from slowhop_search. Fetched live from Slowhop's own JSON API (typically well under 1 s via direct fetch; more when it falls back to an unblocker). Result: { source, fetchedAt, place: { id, slug, name, url, type, currency, summary, highlights, description, texts, location, rating, reviews_count, recent_reviews, host, max_guests, min_age, units, rent_type, check_in, check_out, quiet_hours, flexible_check_in, pets, house_rules, for_whom, food, amenities, internet, nearby, getting_there, fees, discounts, payment, lowest_price, instant_booking, photos }, stay?: { date_from, date_to, nights, adults, children_ages, pets, available, price, price_per_night, currency, breakdown: { nightly_rates, last_minute_discount, first_minute_discount, children_discount, children_fee, cleaning_fee, pets_fee }, meal_plan, min_nights, units, booking_url, calculator_quote?, note? } }. `stay.price` is the total for the whole stay and party (nightly rates after discounts + children's, cleaning and pet fees); `stay.available` is true, false (a `note` says why and what to change) or null when Slowhop's availability calendar did not answer (priced, but the minimum stay is unverified). When `available` is false, `price`, `price_per_night` and `breakdown` are null and `units` empty — never quote such a stay; if Slowhop's calculator still priced it (it ignores minimum stays and pets a place refuses), its figures are in `calculator_quote` { price, price_per_night, breakdown, units, note } for reference only.

children_ages.description: Each child's age in years (0–17), e.g. [4, 9] for two children — prices depend on ages. Default none.

date_from.description: Check-in date, YYYY-MM-DD — pass with date_to to price the stay.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh fetch and bypass this server's result cache (5 min). Default false.

pets.description: The animals coming along, one entry each: 'small_dog', 'medium_dog', 'big_dog', 'cat' (e.g. ['big_dog', 'cat']). Also limits results to places that accept them. Default none.

place.description: The place's slug from slowhop_search (e.g. '6639-dom-na-mazurach-sasek-wielki'), its slowhop.com URL (…/pl/miejsca/<slug>.html), or its numeric id.
